nodes.label: Custom admin decision (not Strapi/headless CMS)
nodes.rationale: Content volume is small (dozens of items), solo project with a single-repo requirement, added manually. A separate CMS adds infrastructure, a second auth system, and upgrade overhead not justified at this scale; a custom /admin backed by Prisma is faster to build and simpler to run. Revisit Strapi/Payload if editors or workflows grow.

nodes.label: Admin auth (NextAuth Credentials; owner/editor roles)
nodes.rationale: Single AdminUser table, no public accounts; NextAuth recommended over hand-rolling session security; /admin/** gated in the segment root layout, redirecting to /admin/login.

nodes.label: Admin CRUD surfaces per content type
nodes.rationale: One section per schema model, including courses, products/tags, class sessions, achievements/tags, licenses, team, FAQs, videos, downloads hierarchy, software, datasheets, articles, jobs, leads, feedback, contact, homepage stats.

nodes.label: Reusable AdminForm / DataTable CRUD pattern (Tiptap)
nodes.rationale: One config-driven AdminForm instead of a bespoke form per type; side-by-side FA/EN fields reduce the chance of shipping half-translated content; every image upload goes through the 05 upload security checklist.

nodes.label: Leads dashboard as notification surface
nodes.rationale: Landing page of /admin shows recent leads with a prominent new count; there is no email notification pipeline, so the dashboard itself is the notification surface.

nodes.label: Admin explicitly out of scope for v1
nodes.rationale: No multi-level approvals, no public accounts, no analytics dashboards inside admin (use Umami directly), no payment/order management.

hyperedges.label: Lead-capture forms to admin notification surface
